name: ui-tick
prompt: A soft, dry fingertip tap on a small wooden button, very short and gentle.

name: select-chime
prompt: A gentle two-note wooden xylophone chime, warm and affirmative.

name: deselect-thunk
prompt: A single soft, low wooden thunk, like setting a small cup down on a table.

name: step-knock
prompt: A light, soft knock on a wooden tabletop, short and muted.

name: serve-tray
prompt: A ceramic cup placed gently on a wooden tray with a soft clink.

name: together-bells
prompt: Two small hand bells rung together in quick succession, bright and cheerful.

name: tidy-swipe
prompt: A soft cloth wiping across a wooden counter with a quick swish and a small tap at the end.

name: wish-new-plink
prompt: A single delicate glass plink, like a drop landing in a quiet room.

name: miss-sigh
prompt: A soft, low descending slide whistle fading out gently, like a balloon slowly deflating.

name: invalid-knocks
prompt: Two quick, muted thumps on a hollow wooden box, like a closed door being tapped twice.

name: round-bell
prompt: A small brass service bell rung once, clear and warm.

name: win-fanfare
prompt: A cheerful small hand-bell jingle followed by a bright rising cascade of chimes.

name: lose-fade
prompt: A slow, soft downward chime fading into silence, like a music box winding down.

name: undo-rewind
prompt: A quick, soft reverse swish, like a sheet of paper being slid back across a desk.

name: hint-sparkle
prompt: Two small bright glass sparkles, like tiny wind chimes touched lightly.

name: purchase-coin
prompt: A small coin dropped into a wooden cashbox with a soft clack.

name: star-twinkle
prompt: A single high, delicate twinkle, like a tiny silver bell.

name: messy-clatter
prompt: A small ceramic plate and a teaspoon set down carelessly on a wooden counter with a light clatter and a few crumbs scattering, short and close.

name: patience-tick
prompt: Two quick, nervous ticks of a small wooden mantel clock, dry and close, no ring.

name: streak-chime
prompt: Three ascending bright wooden xylophone notes played quickly in a row, playful and rewarding, with a short warm ring.

name: day-late-block
prompt: A single soft, low wooden temple block strike with a gentle hollow ring, calm but urgent.

name: ambience-clubhouse
prompt: Quiet cozy indoor room tone of a small wooden clubhouse at evening: a soft fireplace crackling gently in the background, a faint wall clock ticking, an occasional muffled creak of wooden floorboards, no voices, no music, steady and calm.
